name: White Line
desc: If you control a WATER monster: Target 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls; you take no effect damage for the rest of this turn, also change that monster to Defense Position, and if you do, negate its effects. If you control 2 or more monsters with the same name and this card is in your GY: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "White Line" once per turn.
